articles.title: Seeking Refuge on Resolution Island

articles.summary: New Zealanders have long imagined Resolution Island as a place without predators for native birds. However, swimming stoats have shown their own determination.

articles.title: NASA Enhances Supplier Program, Announces Mentor-Protégé Agreement
articles.snippet: How NASA works with small businesses is evolving, and as a result, the agency is strengthening the domestic aerospace industrial base to support future exploration missions through its recently renamed Small Business Supplier Development Program. As part...
articles.summary: NASA announced a mentor-protégé agreement and is updating how it works with small businesses. Through its newly renamed Small Business Supplier Development Program, NASA is strengthening the country's aerospace businesses for future exploration missions.

articles.summary: NASA is preparing for future missions to the Moon and Mars. Researchers are studying different crops that could give astronauts fresh food, nutrition, and variety for their menus in deep space.

articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Views Ocean of Stars in Groundwork for Roman
articles.snippet: These Hubble observations are part of a survey that will help researchers better interpret upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they seek to characterize the stars and search for exoplanets in this busy region of our galaxy.
articles.summary: NASA’s Hubble viewed an ocean of stars in a busy part of our galaxy. This survey will help researchers understand upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they study the stars and search for exoplanets.

articles.title: Insects once had 24 legs
articles.snippet: A many-legged creature from long ago helps fill a major gap in the fossil record — and hints at how today’s insects ended up with just six legs.
articles.summary: Insects once had 24 legs, and a many-legged creature from long ago helps fill a big gap in the fossil record. It also hints at how today’s insects ended up with just six legs.
